Title: 2017-09-08 PTR Patch
Subtitle: === Heroes: Anub'arak ===
CleanedNotes:
=== Heroes: Anub'arak ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue causing the Neon Cyb'arak Skin to replace the base Cyb'arak Anub'arak Skin in-game and in the Collection.

=== Heroes: Gazlowe ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Scrap will no longer be created when Leoric's Entomb expires.

=== Heroes: Lt. Morales ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed an issue that could allow the Lt. Morales player to issue Move Commands to an active Medivac under certain circumstances.

=== Heroes: Rehgar ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Can no longer cast Lightning Shield on allied Vehicles, such as the Dragon Knight or Garden Terror.

=== Heroes: Zeratul ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • The Seeker in the Dark talent's tooltip text will now display correctly in localized game clients.

Heroes: Anub\u0027arak: • Fixed an issue causing the Neon Cyb'arak Skin to replace the base Cyb'arak Anub'arak Skin in-game and in the Collection.
Heroes: Gazlowe: • Scrap will no longer be created when Leoric's Entomb expires.
Heroes: Lt. Morales: • Fixed an issue that could allow the Lt. Morales player to issue Move Commands to an active Medivac under certain circumstances.
Heroes: Rehgar: • Can no longer cast Lightning Shield on allied Vehicles, such as the Dragon Knight or Garden Terror.
Heroes: Zeratul: • The Seeker in the Dark talent's tooltip text will now display correctly in localized game clients.
